This is a demo fleet

Three cars in Orlando and a trip in progress. On your fleet, iris answers with your cars, your pickup spots and your rules.

What she handles, start to finish

Pickups that run themselves

The lockbox code goes out only when the license is verified, check-in is done and pickup is 30 minutes away. Airport guests get the garage, the row and the shuttle route for their terminal.

Extensions that turn into revenue

Before she says yes, she checks four things: the car is listed, the dates are free, nothing is blocked, and there's room before the next trip.

Car trouble, sorted fast

A warning light gets questions first. Oil or anything red, she tells the guest to pull over and alerts you. A flat goes to Turo roadside, a bulb to AutoZone with a receipt refund.

Proof for every dispute

Dirt, smoke and damage from before the trip get logged with the time, so the next guest isn't blamed and you have evidence for the claim.

She never works alone

"I'll ask my team and get right back to you."

Anything sensitive, and anything she doesn't know, gets this answer. She never guesses. The case goes to you and to our team.

Money is never her call

She doesn't offer refunds, discounts or car swaps, and she never names a dollar amount. A review threat or an upset guest goes straight to you.

Our team checks her work

Seasoned Turo hosts review her conversations every day and fix anything she got wrong.

Every conversation is logged, word for word. Read the whole night with your morning coffee.

She learns your fleet, then keeps learning

  1. You answer a short questionnaire

    Your cars, pickup spots, and your rules for tolls, fuel and late returns. That's what she uses to guide your guests from day one.

  2. She starts answering, with the team behind her

    What she knows, she answers in about a minute. What she doesn't, she brings to you and to us.

  3. Repeat questions become standard answers

    Once you've decided how to handle something, she handles it herself the next time.

She starts with what you told her and gets better with every question she had to bring to the team.

Fast replies become five stars

Communication is one of the things guests rate on every trip. Quick, correct answers are how hosts collect five-star reviews, and reviews are how fleets grow.

Questions hosts actually ask

What happens after the 3 days?

You pick a plan or walk away. There's no card up front, so there's nothing to cancel and no surprise charge. Your 3 days start when iris goes live on your fleet, not when you sign up.

What if she doesn't know the answer?

She tells your guest "I'll ask my team and get right back to you". She does that every time, for anything sensitive or new, and the case goes to you and to our team. Once a question comes up often in your fleet, it becomes a standard answer she handles herself.

How does setup work?

You answer a short questionnaire about your fleet: cars, pickup spots, and your rules for tolls, fuel and late returns. That's what iris uses to guide your guests from day one.

Will Turo ban this?

iris works like a co-host team. She answers, experienced Turo hosts review her work, and you set the rules.

What about angry guests?

She acknowledges fast, gives real information and makes no promises she can't keep. Anything about money, or a review threat, goes straight to you.

Does she speak Spanish?

Sí. Portuguese too. Your guest writes in any language and iris answers in the same one.

What do you do with my data?

Your fleet data answers your guests. We don't sell it, share it, or train public models on it.
